## Professional Summary
- 5+ years in software engineering, technical curriculum development and tech mentorship (Techtonica, May 2021 to present).
- Runs ComadreLab, a web studio for small businesses, and MujerTech, a 16-week AI and business bootcamp for women entrepreneurs in Latin America.
- Two decades in communications and project management before moving into tech.

## Shipped Work
- ComadreLab: six client projects shipped and supported since 2024.
- MujerTech: live and running with its first cohort of 25 learners.
- Picas y Fijas: played by 1,092 people across 177 cities.
- Nouvie: order and inventory system running in production for a Colombian cleaning products company.
- Techtonica: 50+ engineers mentored and onboarded since 2021.

## Projects

### Anzuelo
Social media lead finder and content hub. A Python agent searches seven platforms, scores each lead with Claude Haiku using prompt caching, and flags content gaps into Supabase. A Next.js 16 dashboard adds a content studio that generates posts and finished visuals through chained Visual Director and FLUX image agents. No automatic sending, by design.
URL: https://anzuelo.vercel.app

### ASCII Art Converter
A lightweight web tool that converts images into ASCII art for fun, creative outputs, and quick shareable demos. Features include multiple character ramps, color themes, histogram equalization, and PNG export.
URL: https://www.yosola.co/ascii/

### MujerTech: AI & Business Bootcamp
A bilingual learning platform built solo, from data model to deploy: Next.js App Router, next-intl, Supabase magic-link auth, strict TypeScript and a role-gated admin. Three scaffolded modules end in an authentic assessment where learners build a real marketing piece — designed around "La IA propone, tú decides": AI as a helper, not a replacement. Live with 25 learners.
URL: https://bootcamp.mujertech.org

### Bulls and Cows Game
A fun, interactive code-breaking game where you guess a secret number using logical clues ("bulls" and "cows"). Available in English and Spanish (as "Picas y Fijas"). Played by 1,092 people across 177 cities worldwide.
URL: https://www.picasyfijas.com/

### Cristina Multiverse
A creative project demonstrating the capabilities of Stable Diffusion models combined with storytelling. Explores AI-generated imagery in narrative contexts.
URL: https://github.com/Yosolita1978/Cristina-Multiverse (deployment retired, source on GitHub)

### Sustainability Bot
An AI-powered research assistant designed to help organizations create sustainability implementation guides. Uses an agentic AI setup with observability to optimize token usage and generate outputs like PDFs—without relying on a chatbot interface.
URL: https://github.com/Yosolita1978/sustainability-ai-platform (deployment retired, source on GitHub)

### Soneto Bot
A creative AI project that generates original Spanish sonnets inspired by user prompts. Blends language models with classical poetic structure to celebrate the art of poetry in the digital age.
URL: https://sonetobot.vercel.app/
